semantic_models.name: events
semantic_models.description: Releases and maintainer annotations used for association comparisons.

semantic_models.name: fct_fork_history
semantic_models.description: Fork history from the creation dates of existing direct forks.

semantic_models.name: fct_issues
semantic_models.description: Issue and pull request activity without titles, bodies, or author identities.

semantic_models.name: fct_legacy
semantic_models.description: Governed fct_legacy analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.

semantic_models.name: fct_observations
semantic_models.description: Governed fct_observations analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.

semantic_models.name: fct_package_downloads
semantic_models.description: Optional package-registry downloads (PyPI via pypistats, npm via the npm API).

semantic_models.name: fct_path
semantic_models.description: Governed fct_path analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.

semantic_models.name: fct_referrer
semantic_models.description: Governed fct_referrer analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.

semantic_models.name: fct_release_downloads
semantic_models.description: GitHub release asset download balances captured by collection.

semantic_models.name: fct_star_history
semantic_models.description: Star history from the dates current stargazers starred the repository.

semantic_models.name: fct_traffic
semantic_models.description: Governed fct_traffic analytics; see docs/metrics.md for interpretation.

metrics.name: views
metrics.label: Views
metrics.description: Total GitHub page views. May include automated activity.

metrics.name: clones
metrics.label: Clones
metrics.description: Total GitHub clones; not installations or active users.

metrics.name: visitor_days
metrics.label: Visitor Days
metrics.description: Sum of daily unique visitors. Counts the same visitor again on another day or repository.

metrics.name: cloner_days
metrics.label: Cloner Days
metrics.description: Sum of daily unique cloners. Not distinct people over the whole period.

metrics.name: observed_traffic_days
metrics.label: Observed Traffic Days
metrics.description: Count of observed repository-days. For complete coverage expect calendar days multiplied by the number of selected repositories; missing dates contribute no row and are not zero-traffic days.

metrics.name: stars_observed
metrics.label: Stars Observed
metrics.description: Last observed repository star total within each time bucket, separately per repository.

metrics.name: forks_observed
metrics.label: Forks Observed
metrics.description: Last observed repository fork total within each time bucket, separately per repository.

metrics.name: stars_net_change
metrics.label: Stars Net Change
metrics.description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.

metrics.name: forks_net_change
metrics.label: Forks Net Change
metrics.description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.

metrics.name: legacy_stars_cumulative
metrics.label: Legacy Stars Cumulative
metrics.description: Upstream reconstructed star history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical observed totals.

metrics.name: legacy_forks_cumulative
metrics.label: Legacy Forks Cumulative
metrics.description: Upstream reconstructed fork history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical observed totals.

metrics.name: referrer_views_14d
metrics.label: Referrer Views 14D
metrics.description: Reported referrer views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never sum snapshots.

metrics.name: referrer_visitor_observations_14d
metrics.label: Referrer Visitor Observations 14D
metrics.description: Reported referrer unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.

metrics.name: path_views_14d
metrics.label: Path Views 14D
metrics.description: Reported path views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never sum snapshots.

metrics.name: path_visitor_observations_14d
metrics.label: Path Visitor Observations 14D
metrics.description: Reported path unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.

metrics.name: views_per_visitor_day
metrics.label: Views Per Visitor Day
metrics.description: Total page views divided by the sum of daily unique visitor observations over the same UTC period. Ratio of sums, not an average of daily ratios and not distinct people over the period. Zero denominator returns null.

metrics.name: clones_per_cloner_day
metrics.label: Clones Per Cloner Day
metrics.description: Total clone operations divided by the sum of daily unique cloner observations over the same UTC period. Ratio of sums, not installations, active users, or a conversion rate. Zero denominator returns null.

metrics.name: watchers_observed
metrics.label: Watchers Observed
metrics.description: Last observed GitHub watcher (subscriber) total within each time bucket, separately per repository.

metrics.name: open_issues_and_prs_observed
metrics.label: Open Issues and PRs Observed
metrics.description: Last observed open issues plus open pull requests (GitHub open_issues_count), separately per repository.

metrics.name: legacy_stars_change
metrics.label: Legacy Stars Change
metrics.description: Change in the upstream reconstructed star balance; historical, not observed captures.

metrics.name: legacy_forks_change
metrics.label: Legacy Forks Change
metrics.description: Change in the upstream reconstructed fork balance; historical, not observed captures.

metrics.name: events
metrics.label: Events
metrics.description: Published releases and maintainer annotations dated in the period.

metrics.name: stars_gained
metrics.label: Stars Gained
metrics.description: Stars from current stargazers by the day they starred. Unstars are invisible; complete only through the last fully collected day.

metrics.name: forks_created
metrics.label: Forks Created
metrics.description: Existing direct forks by creation day. Deleted forks are invisible; complete only through the last fully collected day.

metrics.name: issues_opened
metrics.label: Issues Opened
metrics.description: Issues opened in the period, excluding pull requests.

metrics.name: issues_closed
metrics.label: Issues Closed
metrics.description: Issues closed in the period by close date, excluding pull requests.

metrics.name: prs_opened
metrics.label: PRs Opened
metrics.description: Pull requests opened in the period.

metrics.name: prs_merged
metrics.label: PRs Merged
metrics.description: Pull requests merged in the period by merge date.

metrics.name: first_time_contributor_prs
metrics.label: First-Time Contributor PRs
metrics.description: Pull requests GitHub marked as from first-time contributors when first collected. Backfilled history undercounts; this is not distinct new people.

metrics.name: median_hours_to_merge
metrics.label: Median Hours to Merge
metrics.description: Median hours from opening to merge for pull requests merged in the period.

metrics.name: release_downloads
metrics.label: Release Downloads
metrics.description: Cumulative GitHub release asset downloads at the last capture in each bucket. Not unique users or installations.

metrics.name: release_downloads_net_change
metrics.label: Release Downloads Net Change
metrics.description: Release asset download change between consecutive daily captures; gaps are null.

metrics.name: package_downloads
metrics.label: Package Downloads
metrics.description: Registry downloads across configured packages. Includes CI and bots; not installations or users.

metrics.name: pypi_downloads
metrics.label: PyPI Downloads
metrics.description: PyPI downloads (pypistats, mirrors excluded) for configured packages. Includes CI; not users.

metrics.name: npm_downloads
metrics.label: npm Downloads
metrics.description: npm registry downloads for configured packages. Includes CI; not users.

metrics.name: stars_from_history
metrics.label: Stars From History
metrics.description: Running total of current stargazers at the end of each period, from star history. People who later unstarred are invisible, so earlier totals can be lower than what was observed at the time.

metrics.name: views_28d
metrics.label: Views (Rolling 28 Days)
metrics.description: GitHub page views over the trailing 28 days ending on the last day of each period. Missing traffic days contribute nothing; check coverage.

metrics.name: views_wow_growth
metrics.label: Views Week-over-Week Growth
metrics.description: Relative change in views versus the previous week; query at week grain. Null when the prior week has no views.

metrics.name: stars_gained_wow_growth
metrics.label: Stars Gained Week-over-Week Growth
metrics.description: Relative change in stars gained versus the previous week; query at week grain. Null when the prior week gained none.

measures.name: cloner_days_measure
measures.description: Sum of daily unique cloners. Not distinct people over the whole period.

measures.name: clones_measure
measures.description: Total GitHub clones; not installations or active users.

measures.name: events_measure
measures.description: Published releases and annotations dated in the period.

measures.name: first_time_contributor_prs_measure
measures.expr: case when kind = 'pull_request' and is_first_time_contributor then 1 else 0 end
measures.description: Pull requests whose author GitHub marked as a first-time contributor when collection first saw them. Backfilled history undercounts.

measures.name: forks_created_measure
measures.description: Existing direct forks created in the period; deleted forks are invisible.

measures.name: forks_net_change_measure
measures.description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.

measures.name: forks_observed_measure
measures.description: Last observed repository fork total within each time bucket, separately per repository.

measures.name: hours_to_merge_measure
measures.description: Median hours from opening to merge for pull requests merged in the period.

measures.name: issues_closed_measure
measures.expr: case when kind = 'issue' and closed_date is not null then 1 else 0 end
measures.description: Issues closed in the period, by close date (excludes pull requests).

measures.name: issues_opened_measure
measures.expr: case when kind = 'issue' then 1 else 0 end
measures.description: Issues opened in the period (excludes pull requests).

measures.name: legacy_forks_change_measure
measures.description: Change in the upstream reconstructed fork balance between historical rows; the first row is null.

measures.name: legacy_forks_cumulative_measure
measures.description: Upstream reconstructed fork history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical observed totals.

measures.name: legacy_stars_change_measure
measures.description: Change in the upstream reconstructed star balance between historical rows; the first row is null.

measures.name: legacy_stars_cumulative_measure
measures.description: Upstream reconstructed star history at the pinned source revision; not exact historical observed totals.

measures.name: observed_traffic_days_measure
measures.description: Observed repository-days. Compare to expected repository-days to check coverage.

measures.name: open_issues_and_prs_observed_measure
measures.description: Last observed open issues plus open pull requests (GitHub open_issues_count) within each time bucket, separately per repository.

measures.name: package_downloads_measure
measures.description: Registry downloads reported for the period; includes CI and bots, PyPI excludes mirrors. Not installations or users.

measures.name: path_views_14d_measure
measures.description: Reported path views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never sum snapshots.

measures.name: path_visitor_observations_14d_measure
measures.description: Reported path unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.

measures.name: prs_merged_measure
measures.expr: case when merged_date is not null then 1 else 0 end
measures.description: Pull requests merged in the period, by merge date.

measures.name: prs_opened_measure
measures.expr: case when kind = 'pull_request' then 1 else 0 end
measures.description: Pull requests opened in the period.

measures.name: referrer_views_14d_measure
measures.description: Reported referrer views in the rolling window of the last snapshot in each bucket. Never sum snapshots.

measures.name: referrer_visitor_observations_14d_measure
measures.description: Reported referrer unique observations for one rolling snapshot. Not deduplicated across items.

measures.name: release_downloads_measure
measures.description: Cumulative release asset downloads at the last capture in each bucket, separately per repository. Not unique users or installations.

measures.name: release_downloads_net_change_measure
measures.description: Release asset download change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial captures are null.

measures.name: stars_gained_measure
measures.description: Current stargazers who starred in the period. Unstars are invisible, so history counts only people who still star the repository.

measures.name: stars_net_change_measure
measures.description: Net change between consecutive daily captures; gaps and initial observations are null.

measures.name: stars_observed_measure
measures.description: Last observed repository star total within each time bucket, separately per repository.

measures.name: views_measure
measures.description: Total GitHub page views. May include automated activity.

measures.name: visitor_days_measure
measures.description: Sum of daily unique visitors. Counts the same visitor again on another day or repository.

measures.name: watchers_observed_measure
measures.description: Last observed GitHub watcher (subscriber) total within each time bucket, separately per repository. Null before collection captured it.
